messages:
Anna: Heads-up — saw a regression on canary this morning after the recent kernel-selection change. P99 token latency for some conversational routes jumped ~120ms. :eyes:
Mike: ugh. is it across the board or per-route?
Anna: looks concentrated to two high-traffic routes: /chat/compose and /chat/assist. p50 fine, p95 small bump, p99 spike.
Sara: can you paste the token-level breakdown? decode vs kernel vs network?
Anna: yes — ran a quick sample from tracing. token breakdown (median of sampled requests):
```
decode: 6ms
kernel_compute: 78ms
kv_lookup: 5ms
network: 2ms
other: 3ms
```
Anna: for p99 it's kernel_compute that jumps (to ~200ms) but kernel selection metrics show we switched to the newer fused-attn kernel more often.
Raj: hmm kernel choice change could increase tail if it behaves worse on certain seqlen distributions. Do we have per-kernel histograms?
Devin: not reliably — we emit `runtime_kernel_choice_total{kernel="v2_fused"}` counts, but no per-token-latency by kernel. we should add `token_latency_ms_bucket{kernel=...,stage=...}`.
Mike: also want to check KV prefix reuse: if KV cache misses increase, kernel could be redoing work and blow up. Anna, any change in prefix hit rate?
Anna: prefix-hit-rate (rough sampling) dropped from 84% -> 62% on /chat/assist during the window. eviction rate up by 3x. memory footprint stable though.
Sara: eviction reason tag? was it LRU or explicit GC?
Anna: currently we emit `kv_cache_eviction_total{reason="evict"}` but reason is coarse. Suggest adding `reason="shard_pressure|route_reclaim|time_ttl"`.
Raj: Agree. Also add `kv_prefix_reuse_by_route{route="/chat/assist"}` gauge so dashboards can show reuse fraction by route.
Devin: I'll sketch PromQL queries we can add to the dashboard. Thoughts?
Devin: sample queries:
```
sum by (route) (rate(kv_prefix_hits_total[5m])) / sum by (route) (rate(kv_prefix_requests_total[5m]))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_ms_bucket{stage="kernel_compute"}[5m])) by (le, kernel))

sum(rate(runtime_kernel_choice_total[5m])) by (kernel, route)
```
Mike: Nice. Also add a small panel: per-route token latency waterfall with stacked series for decode/kernel/kv so we can eyeball which stage changes first.
Anna: Dashboard suggestion: a matrix with rows = route, cols = p50/p95/p99 for token-level stages + prefix reuse %, eviction rate, mem bytes. Color warn thresholds: p99 kernel > 150ms or prefix_reuse < 70%.
Sara: For instrumentation rollout, plan: (1) add kernel-tagged token latency histograms (low overhead), (2) add per-route prefix reuse gauge, (3) add eviction-reason label, (4) increase sampling on canary for traces.
Raj: Can we gate any of this behind a feature flag? we should avoid global metric cardinality explosion.
Devin: yes — metrics will default off per-route; enable-by-config for top N routes. also cap label values.
perf-bot: `CI`: small PR opened: https://repo/pull/4123 adding kernel label to token latency histograms — perf test pending. :thumbsup:
Anna: thanks — after PR lands I'll run a targeted canary with increased sampling and dashboard panels.
Mike: if we confirm kernel is culprit, rollback and iterate on kernel impl. If it's cache churn, focus on eviction tuning and maybe increase prefix shard size for those routes.
Sara: adding follow-up: run flamegraph of kernel execution for p99 samples, and compare seqlen distribution for affected routes.
Anna: assigned tasks: Devin -> dashboard queries + panel templates, Raj -> metric design and feature-flag, Devin -> open PR (linked above), Sara -> flamegraph run, me -> run canary and collect traces.
Raj: solid. ping me in thread when canary data ready.
Anna: will do. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
